# Corporate Travel & Expense Policy

## Section 1: Airfare and Lodging

1.1 Economy class airfare is reimbursed for domestic flights, except when a medical accommodation is approved in advance by HR.

1.2 Hotel stays above $250 per night are not reimbursed, unless the conference host hotel rate exceeds the cap and is pre-approved under Clause 2.1.

## Section 2: Pre-Approval Rules

2.1 Written pre-approval from a Vice President is required for any exception to standard lodging or airfare caps, provided that the request includes two comparable quotes.
